title: 第2518章 悬赏缉拿第2517章 再造之恩
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
白秀秀，你瞎想什么呢？看到的未必是事实。
之前你还认为师尊的丹道实力很一般，你还想教人家来着。
现在知道了吧，师尊的丹道实力强大到你想象不到的程度，至少在六阶层次的丹道理论上，师尊绝不比顶级丹君差。
从这点便可以判断，师尊的武道修为肯定也作弊了，他老人家很可能是六阶巅峰修士，只是把修为隐匿到六阶一层而已。
师尊这么做的目的，估计是为了寻找师娘更方便一些，毕竟六阶一层修士刚突破，普遍都很穷，不容易被高阶修士惦记。
白秀秀猜到这个结果，心里还是很高兴。
不管怎么说，凡事先往好的方面想，至少自己不用一直为师尊担惊受怕，可以专心修炼丹道。
天下本无事，庸人自扰之，自己必须保持良好的心态，这样才能事半功倍。
白秀秀回到宗门的第一件事，便是打听佟姥的消息。
确定佟姥并不在宗门，白秀秀便把搜寻任务交给他人操作，这妞知道凭自己一人之力，想要寻找百年前消失的师母，无异于白日做梦。
与其如此，还不如好好提升丹道实力，只有炼出高品质的丹药才能获得更多的财富。
再用这些财富驱使更多的人为自己做事，这样才是解决问题的最佳方式。
白秀秀想通其中的关窍，这妞便不再纠结这件事情。
手头的资金也分成两部分，一部分用来找人做事，又拿出十万紫晶在附近几个城池悬赏缉拿佟姥。
另一部分全部用来购买药材，提升自身的丹道实力，好赚更多的钱，把摊子铺得更大一些。
黄夜还不知道自己多了一个忠心耿耿的徒弟，而这徒弟无时无刻不想着把自己睡了。
白秀秀也确实很努力，加上这妞天赋异禀，这妞的丹道实力以肉眼可见的速度突飞猛进。
不到一年时间便炼制出极品两纹的聚欢丹，这妞又用了两年时间，把黄夜提供的另外两种丹药炼制到极品两纹层次。
白秀秀也真正成为修仙界的小富婆，好在吃水不忘挖井人，这妞也不敢乱得瑟，没见到师尊前，白秀秀可不敢包养小白脸。
这次不止白秀秀接到这个任务，陈玲儿也接到相同的任务。

听完黄夜的叙述，陈玲儿才知道黄夜这次过来真正目标是寻找佟姥，并非为了竞拍灵火，自己属于黄夜搂草打兔子的赠品。
替陈玲儿做事的人可不少，这妞也是行动派，接到黄夜的指示，这妞迅速安排手下人搜寻。
有黄夜提供的聚宝金卡，这妞也是不惜重金，悬赏活捉佟姥。
黄夜原计划试探一下杨管事，看他能不能帮忙，没想到陈玲儿主动送上门。
虽然这妞过于精打细算，但她的长处也不少，至少这妞愿意付出一切，借助身体优势建立庞大的关系网。
别看这妞的容貌并不出色，但她的气质优雅，从事的工作也很体面，看中这妞的都是有实力的修士。
所以陈玲儿的办事效率很高，有不少势力都知道这妞在寻找一个名字叫佟湘翠的女修。
欢喜郡是个临河而建的城池，合欢帝宫的女修穿着确实很开放，什么露背装、露肩装、露胸装、露脐装、露腿装都有。
保守一点的会在外面罩上一层轻纱，主打一个半遮半掩。
content_en:
Bai Xiuxiu, what are you thinking about? What you see may not be the truth.
Before, you thought that Master's alchemy strength was average, and you still wanted to teach him.
Now you know, the master’s alchemy strength is so powerful that you can’t imagine. At least in terms of six-level alchemy theory, the master is no worse than the top alchemy king.
From this point, it can be judged that the master must have cheated on his martial arts cultivation. He is probably a peak sixth-level monk who just hid his cultivation to the sixth level.
The purpose of the master's doing this is probably to make it easier to find the master's wife. After all, the sixth-level and first-level monks have just broken through and are generally poor, so they are not easily missed by high-level monks.
Bai Xiuxiu guessed this result and was still very happy.
No matter what, think about the good things in advance. At least you don't have to worry about Master all the time and can concentrate on practicing alchemy.
There is nothing wrong with the world, and it is up to others to disturb themselves. You must maintain a good attitude, so that you can get twice the result with half the effort.
The first thing Bai Xiuxiu did when she returned to the sect was to inquire about Tong Lao.
After confirming that Tong Lao was not in the sect, Bai Xiuxiu handed over the search task to others. This girl knew that trying to find the master's wife who disappeared a hundred years ago was nothing more than a daydream on her own.
Instead of doing this, it is better to improve the strength of the alchemy. Only by refining high-quality elixirs can you gain more wealth.
Using this wealth to drive more people to do things for themselves is the best way to solve the problem.
Bai Xiuxiu figured out the key, and the girl no longer struggled with the matter.
The funds on hand were also divided into two parts. One part was used to find people to do things, and another 100,000 amethysts were used to put bounties on Tong Lao in several nearby cities.
The other part is used to buy medicinal materials and improve one's alchemy strength so that one can make more money and open a bigger stall.
Huang Ye didn't know that he had a loyal apprentice, and this apprentice wanted to sleep with him all the time.
Bai Xiuxiu worked really hard. Coupled with this girl's extraordinary talent, her alchemy strength increased by leaps and bounds at a speed visible to the naked eye.
It took less than a year to refine the top-grade two-line Juhuan Pill. This girl spent another two years refining the other two pills provided by Huang Ye to the top-grade two-line level.
Bai Xiuxiu has truly become a little rich woman in the world of immortality. Fortunately, she does not forget the well digger. This girl does not dare to act recklessly. Bai Xiuxiu does not dare to support the pretty girl before meeting her master.
This time, not only Bai Xiuxiu received this task, but Chen Ling'er also received the same task.
After listening to Huang Ye's narration, Chen Ling'er realized that Huang Ye's real purpose of coming here this time was to find Grandma Tong, not to bid for the spiritual fire. She was a gift from Huang Ye's hunting of rabbits.
There are many people working for Chen Ling'er, and this girl is also an action person. After receiving Huang Ye's instructions, this girl quickly arranged for her men to search.
With the gold treasure card provided by Huang Ye, this girl also spared no expense in offering a reward for capturing Grandma Tong alive.
Huang Ye originally planned to test Manager Yang to see if he could help, but Chen Ling'er unexpectedly came to her door.
Although this girl is too calculating, she also has many advantages. At least this girl is willing to give everything and use her physical advantages to build a huge network of relationships.
Even though this girl's appearance is not outstanding, she has an elegant temperament and a decent job. Those who like this girl are all capable monks.
Therefore, Chen Ling'er works very efficiently. Many forces know that this girl is looking for a female cultivator named Tong Xiangcui.
Huanxi County is a city built next to the river. The female cultivators in the Hehuan Imperial Palace are indeed very open-minded in their clothing. They have all kinds of backless, shoulder-baring, breast-baring, navel-baring, and leg-baring dresses.
Those who are more conservative will put a layer of gauze on the outside, focusing on half-covering and half-covering.
